mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM user_access_review rm left join its_application_data app on rm.cmdb_id = app.cmdb_id left join ad_tb_upp_nature_2 staff on rm.it_code_of_user = staff.user_name left join ad_tb_upp_nature_2 mger on rm.line_manager = mger.user_name
order by rm.sequence_number

SELECT sequence_number, it_code_of_user, staff.email, staff.real_name user_real_name, rm.user_name, staff.country, department, app.cmdb_id, app.application_name as app_name, user_id, user_id_valid_to, authorization_technical_name, authorization_description, authorization_valid_to, first_line_manager, second_line_manager, it_code_of_bpo, user_id_lock, access_review_decision, audit_trail, system_role, role_description, leit_system_id, leit_system_name, final_review_decision, line_manager, bpo, bpo_email, user_coc_type, bpo_coc_type, line_manager_email,
CASE bpo_review_status WHEN '1' THEN '未审核' WHEN '2' THEN '已审核' ELSE COALESCE(bpo_review_status, '未知') END AS bpo_review_status,
CASE bpo_review_status WHEN '1' THEN 'Pending Review' WHEN '2' THEN 'Reviewed' ELSE COALESCE(bpo_review_status, 'Unknown') END AS bpo_review_status,
CASE line_manager_review_status WHEN '1' THEN '未审核' WHEN '2' THEN '已审核' ELSE COALESCE(line_manager_review_status, '未知') END AS line_manager_review_status,
CASE line_manager_review_status WHEN '1' THEN 'Pending Review' WHEN '2' THEN 'Reviewed' ELSE COALESCE(line_manager_review_status, 'Unknown') END AS line_manager_review_status,
NULLIF(NULLIF(rm.access_label, 'LEIT_empty'), '') AS access_label,
CASE bpo_review_decision WHEN 'keep' THEN '保留' WHEN 'remove' THEN '移除' ELSE COALESCE(bpo_review_decision, '') END AS bpo_review_decision,
CASE line_managers_review_decision WHEN 'keep' THEN '保留' WHEN 'remove' THEN '移除' ELSE COALESCE(line_managers_review_decision, '') END AS line_managers_review_decision
NULLIF(NULLIF(rm.access_label, 'LEIT_empty'), '') AS access_label,
COALESCE(bpo_review_decision, '') AS bpo_review_decision, COALESCE(line_managers_review_decision, '') AS line_managers_review_decision
FROM user_access_review rm left join its_application_data app on rm.cmdb_id = app.cmdb_id left join ad_tb_upp_nature_2 staff on rm.it_code_of_user = staff.user_name
ORDER BY rm.sequence_number

select count(*) as all, COALESCE(sum(case when line_manager_review_status ='1' then 1 else 0 end ), 0) as pendingProcessing, COALESCE(sum(case when line_manager_review_status ='2' then 1 else 0 end ), 0) as completed from user_access_review
delete_flag = false
AND line_manager
#{item}
